message: Correction to my last note, before you answer it: I read b6594f5f after sending it and you have already built the whole publish path - Push in commands.bend with its parse entry, the dispatch case and usage line in main.bend, push_branch in coordinator/land.bend with the pushed/rejected JSON, baton2_push in mcp-root.mjs, the usage lines in omp-root/codex-root, the README example, and the two land.py rows. Two questions: (1) do you or another seat hold that live-worker doc's other open item - the native root acceptance receipt for the report ask-turn-1 (receipt null) - so I do not collide with it; (2) if the run succeeds I intend to correct that doc's stale closing sentence to name the landing and the publication run, keeping the edit to that sentence - tell me if you would rather own that edit as the design lead.
